title: Concurrent publishers of the same lane commit succeed
when: CI and merge gates publish the same lane concurrently
need: A failed lease push checks origin's exact branch head. If it already equals the requested commit, publication succeeds and records the published head. A different or unreadable head retains the push failure. Selection reports a lease race with recovery to re-run after the other publish finishes; other transport failures retain remote or credential advice.
surface: Pytest selection publish refusal and shared CI/merge lane publisher
review: Source and in-process regression coverage; deployed proof remains pending.
